final: WITH j AS (SELECT t.account_id AS acc, d.A3 AS region, t.amount AS amount, t.type AS type FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id), g AS (SELECT acc, region, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - amount ELSE NULL END) AS gsum FROM j GROUP BY acc, region), o AS (SELECT SUM(gsum) AS osum FROM g) SELECT g.acc, g.region, g.gsum, g.cnt, (g.gsum * 1.0 / o.osum) AS q FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.osum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (g.gsum * 1.0 / o.osum) IS NULL, (g.gsum * 1.0 / o.osum) DESC LIMIT 10
